note: The one home of the Pods numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Pods §5, §6). Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. What is not in the layout document is listed under `derived`, each waiting for the UI designer. Laid out the concept's way round (UI designer, 2026-10-08): the wells at the far left, the page left of the pod on Compare's columns, the pod on its frosted dish under the cone of light, its name and origin under it, the stamp label at the right; was the page at the right (528, 112, 480, 440) and the stamp under the pod (176, 432), the pod on (344, 312), the cradle 224×40. After the art director's second verdict (UI designer, 2026-10-08): the dish (600, 328, 224, 96) with its near lip on the same rectangle (was 600, 352, 224, 72); the rail hanging from y 40, 40 tall, by frame.rail (was 176, 48, 832, 56); the origin in bone (was mist); the page opening on one large picture (Picture) with the grid as its second state; the focus graph gains the page (list.right was pod, pod.left was list.current). After the art director's fourth check (UI designer, 2026-10-08): the pod classes 144×176, 120×152, 104×128 (were 160×192, 136×168, 112×144) on the foot line y 392 (was 400) in the bowl's dip; the Picture state a portrait 200×280 in a 232×312 frame, 16 px inset (was 376×312); the name's plate hugging the word (name.plate). The owner's decision (2026-10-08): the name label at 20 px medium, its text rectangle (600, 440, 224, 24) and its plate 24 tall, at least 80 (were 28 px, 224×32, plate 32 tall, at least 96). After the art director's pass-6 verdict (UI designer, 2026-10-08): the shelf slab (592, 368, 240, 72) under the dish; the name (600, 456, 224, 24) and the origin and ribbon (600, 496, 224, 40), 16 px lower (were at y 440 and 480); the origin has no plate; the rail's ring in the `focus` role (was `cream`). After the owner's rulings on the composite (UI designer, 2026-10-08): the well column 112 (was 160) with 80×80 ring slices, the 32×48 list pod and a circular focus; no place stamps in the list; the page (152, 112, 256, 440) (was 176, 112, 408, 440) with the portrait 192×272 in a 224×304 frame and a two-column grid; the pod's room 408 to 856 with the axis x 632 (was 712); the slab 288 wide; the caption (origin) 8 px under the name; the stamp case (856, 232, 152, 152) and the label (872, 248) (were 848, 144, 176, 328 and 888, 248); the rail's state colours, one fill, word and pip colour per state. After the game designer's answer (2026-10-08; the owner asked): the page is one state, every trait at once by the grid for one to eight traits, each cell the picture, 4 px, the one-word name; no Picture state, no trait marks, no page focus (list.right is the pod again, pod.left the well). The strings other than strings.openBay are the decided strings of the layout document (§5 States, §6). Restructured (UI designer, 2026-10-09, the owner's decision on the wireframes): three states, collection (A), pod overview (B) and chapter page (C), with no well column; regions and focus graphs per state. Was one screen with the well column (list, well, hatch at 16, 488), the pod on the axis x 632, the page (152, 112, 256, 440) and the rail at x 152.

page.sizeRule: UI designer, 2026-10-09, the owner's choice of the open page (B) and his corrections ("too tight… the bird head at 75%… a bit more spacing between cells"): with no pane the page's size bounds the heading's rule and the grid. Columns = the count up to four, then half the count rounded up; width = 24 + columns × 128 + (columns − 1) × 16 = 8 + 144 × columns (152, 296, 440, 584); height 232 for one row (48 + 184), 440 for two (48 + 184 + 24 + 184). Left at x 424, top at y 112, so the heading and the first cell never move as the rail steps; four columns end at x 1008, the screen's right margin. A sealed chapter takes the one-trait size. Was 40 + 136 × columns, 248 or 440, on the pane

lineMarks.fit: the line (name + 4 + glyph …) is centred on the cell and may run 6 px into the 16 px gap on each side (≤ 140), so two neighbouring lines keep 4 px apart.
